facts.fact: MOA is at UBC, 6393 NW Marine Drive. Arrival at UBC Exchange still requires a walk northwest or transfer to bus 68.
Collections include objects from the South Pacific, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas; Indigenous access and originating communities are central to the institution’s stated work.
facts.location: The Collections / Indigenous Access + Engagement sections.

facts.fact: MOA states the building is wheelchair accessible and offers borrowed wheelchairs and portable seats; current seasonal opening conditions must be checked separately.
